reader.notes: ReadSequential answers 10 when no next slot exists and 14 when the slot's digits exceed the key item, both through Unsuccessful (the file position is invalidated); the emitted AT END branch tests status[0] == '1'. The status class tests (CodeGen/Verbs/IoStatusClass.cs), the generated __IoCheck hook (DispatchEmitter.EmitUseMachinery) and the Status setter's permanent-error record are the same code at every edition.
